🚨 TCS Chairman N. Chandrasekaran says AI agents could soon equal the company's human workforce in numbers.
The warning signals a major shift in the IT industry, with AI expected to automate routine work and slow hiring growth. While new opportunities will emerge, the future workforce may look very different from today.
🤖 AI agents + humans = the next workplace reality?
#AI #ArtificialIntelligence #TCS #Technology #FutureOfWork

The best outbound message is usually written before the outreach tool opens.

It starts with the trigger.

Bad:

“Hey, saw you’re building something cool.”

Better:

“saw you’re hiring 2 SDRs while still founder-led on GTM. Usually that means pipeline is working but follow-up + qualification are starting to break. Is that what’s happening?”

That message works because it has a reason to exist.

Trigger → pain hypothesis → specific question.

AI can help find triggers:

hiring
funding
launch
pric

@TechnicalBben Just left LinkedIn now. 

The rate at which companies are hiring GTM engineers is almost frightening. Juicy pay for that matter.

The same AI that made building easy also made distribution difficult (in a way). 

Time for sales and marketing professionals to make it big.
